notes.title: Surfing Legends - Patch Notes v018.00
notes.content:
🏄‍♂️ Attention, legends! We’ve retired the airbeds and introduced two spectacular surfboards featuring legendary Surfing Legends art. But here’s the deal, these boards are for the pros!

🚀 Speed 5 for Maximum Power! While you can ride these boards at Speed 1, they’ll only truly shine once you hit Speed 5. Until then, they’re more style than speed, but totally worth the grind!

✅ Already Completed the Airbed Challenges? Don’t worry, you’re covered! Players who nailed the airbed challenges will automatically receive the upgraded surfboards. The challenge remains the same; it’s just the reward that’s taken a legendary leap!

🌟 Level Up, Unlock, and Dominate! Show the waves who’s boss, and claim your place as a surfing legend. Ready to hit Speed 5 and make it happen?


[i][b]Other Updates and Improvements:[/b][/i]

[b]•[/b] Menu changes, new boards 

[b]• [/b]Rebuilt some levels with improved lighting 

[b]•[/b] Improved translations

notes.title: 🌊 Surfing Legends - Update Announcement 🌊
notes.content:
Hello, Surfing Legends! 

We’re back with another update based on your valuable feedback. Here’s what’s new in this release:

[b]Added Missing Subtitles:[/b] We’ve made sure all dialogue is now accompanied by subtitles, making the story accessible to everyone.

[b]Fixed Duplicate Warnings:[/b] The baby crocodile close to the beach will no longer trigger duplicate warnings. Safety first, surfers!

[b]Menu Enhancements:[/b] We’ve revamped the character/surfboard menu background for a more consistent and immersive experience.

[b]Mouse Hover Issue Resolved:[/b] The level menu now properly displays the level images when hovered over with the mouse, so no more disappearing levels!

Thank you for all your feedback and support. We’re committed to continually improving your gaming experience. Keep riding those waves and let us know what you think of the new updates!

Happy surfing, and see you in the game! 🏄‍♂️🏄‍♀️

notes.title: Surfing Legends - Patch Notes v016.1
notes.content:
Hey Legends,

We’ve been hard at work to enhance your surfing experience. Here’s what’s new in this update:

[b]•[/b] Gameplay Improvements: Enhanced the explanation of mechanics in the intro level for a smoother start.

[b]•[/b] Collision Boundaries: Fine-tuned collision boundaries for a more seamless and accurate gameplay experience.

[b]•[/b] Board Speed Balancing: Better balanced the speed of the boards to improve game flow and challenge.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the waves!

notes.title: New Demo Release! 🔥
notes.content:
We’ve released the game and made significant changes since the release of the old demo, so we recently decided to remove it. 

But as strong believers in '[i]try before you buy[/i],' we’ve created a new demo for you! Check out the updated gameplay, dive in, have fun, and catch you on the next wave with us! 🏄‍♂️

notes.title: Update 26 October 2024 V16.01
notes.content:
The game will now start in Full Screen instead of Windowed Full Screen. (only for new players)
Improved camera collision with falling Rock.

notes.title: 🌊 Get Ready to Ride the Waves! 🌊
notes.content:
Exciting news, everyone! [b]Surfing Legends of the Caribbean[/b], will officially release on October 25, 2024! 🏄‍♂️✨

Dive into a thrilling 3D platformer set on the waves! Surf, rescue wildlife, and collect magical diamonds in this single-player adventure. Unlock faster boards, beat the clock, and explore new levels!

notes.title: Important Announcement: Demo Removal
notes.content:
Dear Surfing Legends Community,

We hope you’ve been enjoying the waves and the thrill of Surfing Legends! We wanted to inform you that we will be removing the demo version of the game soon. This decision comes as we believe the demo no longer accurately reflects the current state of the game due to the numerous updates and improvements we’ve made.

We appreciate your understanding and support as we continue to enhance your surfing experience. Stay tuned for more exciting updates and see you on the waves!

Best regards,
The Surfing Legends Team

notes.title: Surfing Legends Demo v006
notes.content:
[u][b]Version 006 Update: Enhanced Visuals and Audio[/b][/u]

[b]1. Full HD Mode at Start:[/b]
For first-time players, the game now starts in 1920 x 1080 fullscreen mode, providing an immersive experience right from the beginning.

[b]2. Looped Menu Music:[/b]
- We’ve enhanced the audio by looping the menu music. Enjoy a continuous soundtrack as you navigate through the game’s menus.

[b]3. Improved Jump Animation:[/b]
- We’ve revamped the jump animation for a more fluid and dynamic experience. 

[b]4. New Menu Background:[/b]
- Prepare to be captivated by our fresh menu background! It sets the tone for your gaming adventure and adds an extra layer of visual delight.




[u][b]Previous Updates:[/b][/u]

[b]1. Full screen Mode:[/b]
- For first-time players, the game now starts in fullscreen mode instead of windowed fullscreen.

[b]2. Track Enhancements:[/b]
- The starting point of the track has been adjusted for improved flow. 

[b]3. Logo Update: Start Screen Refreshed:[/b]
- Start screen has a new letter type.

[b]4. Reset to Starting Point Fix:[/b]
- We've resolved an issue where players couldn't reset to the starting point. 

[b]5. In-Game Instructions:[/b]
- Added the text prompt with the message: "Press 'P' to pause and see the controls." when the level begins.

[b]6. Disabled Water Effects and Boost on Land:[/b]
- Disabled water effects and boosts on land. 

[b]7. Improved Timing Sound for Jumping Flowers:[/b]
- The timing sound when jumping over flowers has been adjusted for better synchronization.

notes.title: Surfing Legends Demo v005
notes.content:
[u][b]Version 005 Update: Enhancements and Fixes[/b][/u]

[b]1. Disabled Water Effects and Boost on Land:[/b]
- We've fine-tuned the gameplay experience by disabling water effects and boosts on land. Now, your focus will be solely on the track and the challenges ahead.

[b]2. Improved Timing Sound for Jumping Flowers:[/b]
- The timing sound when jumping over flowers has been adjusted for better synchronization. Get ready to leap gracefully through the colorful landscapes!



[u][b]Previous Updates:[/b][/u]

[b]1. Fullscreen Mode:[/b]
- For first-time players, the game now starts in fullscreen mode instead of windowed fullscreen.

[b]2. Track Enhancements:[/b]
- The starting point of the track has been adjusted for improved flow. 

[b]3. Logo Update: Start Screen Refreshed:[/b]
- Start screen has a new letter type.

[b]4. Reset to Starting Point Fix:[/b]
- We've resolved an issue where players couldn't reset to the starting point. 

[b]5. In-Game Instructions:[/b]
- To help new players, we've added a helpful text prompt with the message: "Press 'P' to pause and see the controls." when the level begins.

notes.title: Surfing Legends Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
🌊[b] Surf the Waves of Adventure in “Surfing Legends of the Caribbean” - Demo Out Now! [/b]🏄

Ahoy, mates and wave riders! We’re thrilled to announce that the demo for “Surfing Legends of the Caribbean” is now available for download. Get ready to embark on an epic surfing journey from tropical islands to the arctic, from desert oases to canyon rivers, and beyond.

This demo is just a sneak peek of the grand adventure that awaits.

[b]Try it now and get a feel for the great adventure waiting for you in the full game![/b]

notes.title: Exciting news! 🌊🏄‍♂️
notes.content:
The Surfing Legends Demo is set to ride the waves and make a splash on March 28, 2024! 🎮🌟

In this thrilling single-player adventure, you’ll surf across the globe—from tropical islands to the arctic, from desert oases to canyon rivers, and beyond. Your mission? Rescue endangered wildlife, collect dazzling magic diamonds, and clean up the water by removing oil cans and plastic hazards. Get ready to leap over majestic waterfalls, gather coins, buy awesome boards, and beat the clock! 🏄‍♀️💎🕰️

Mark your calendars, fellow surfers! And join the Surfing Legends on their adventure. 🌊🤙
